before.name: Khalfani Malik Khaldun
before.description: Khalfani Malik Khaldun, legally Leonard B. McQuay and formerly listed as Khalfani X. Khaldun, is a New Afrikan prison organizer incarcerated in Indiana since 1987. While imprisoned on earlier street offenses, he became a political educator and organizer. Indiana later prosecuted him for the 1994 killing of a prison guard; Khaldun has consistently denied responsibility, and supporters argued that officials singled him out because of his conflicts with prison authorities and organizing. After years of litigation he was convicted and received a sixty-year sentence. A January 2026 federal decision confirms that Khaldun and Leonard McQuay are the same person and that he remains imprisoned; the most recent independently located facility record places him at Westville Correctional Facility.
